name: Colby Sain
bio: Colby came to the AMNH as an REU intern. She worked under the mentorship of Ricardo Botero-Trujillo and Stephanie Loria, primarily on Ricinulei, with a focus on the African genus, *Ricinoides*. She generated an extensive set of morphological images, and she also generated molecular data. At the University of Tennessee, she studies Geology with a focus on Paleontology. In the future, Colby hopes to do more work in the Arachnology Lab.
